strings.admin.companion_intro: Open Brew by Weight Companion is an optional helper you run on a computer at home. It opens the Web UI over HTTPS on as many phones, tablets and computers as you like, and with a Linea Micra it can keep the La Marzocco connection so the controller's radio stays free for your scale. Once it runs on your network, it asks to connect here by itself.
strings.admin.companion_lm_approve_hint: On: once you approve, the controller hands the companion your La Marzocco account, encrypted, and the companion takes over the cloud connection. You can change this later.
strings.admin.companion_lm_hint: On: the companion talks to La Marzocco's cloud for the controller. The controller no longer keeps a secure cloud connection open or decodes its messages, so its Wi-Fi and processor stay free for your scale and your shot. Power, brew temperature and backflush work exactly the same, and if the companion goes away the controller connects on its own until it is back. Off: the controller always connects to the cloud and does that work itself, as it does without a companion, and the companion deletes its copy of your La Marzocco account.
strings.admin.companion_log_approve_hint: On: the companion keeps a copy of this controller's diagnostic log, so its history survives restarts and stays readable even while the controller is off. You can change this later.
strings.admin.companion_log_hint: On: the companion keeps a copy of this controller's diagnostic log, so its history survives restarts and busy periods, pages back beyond what the controller keeps in memory, and stays readable even while the controller is off. Off: the controller's log stays in its own memory only, as it does without a companion, and the companion keeps what it already stored.

strings.settings.after_a_start_or_stop_how_long: How long the brew sensor has to confirm a start or stop. After that, it decides.
strings.settings.after_you_start_if_the_scale_st: No coffee on the scale this long after Start? The next tap counts as a new start.
strings.settings.allow_brew_temperature: Set the brew temperature in each preset
strings.settings.allow_brew_temperature_hint: Choosing a preset sends its temperature to the Micra. When off, presets keep their temperatures but don't send them.
strings.settings.allow_rinse_while_armed_hint: Off: with the warning pending, a rinse runs no water and uses up the warning.
strings.settings.always_finishes_by_weight_or_ti: With a scale and By weight on, the shot stops at your yield or Max shot time wherever the paddle is; after the first second the paddle can't stop it early. OFF in the first second stops it, or starts a rinse if Quick rinse is on. Without weight control, OFF stops normally.
strings.settings.app_auto_live: Open the live view when a shot starts
strings.settings.app_auto_live_hint: While you are on Home, a shot opens the full-screen timer by itself.
strings.settings.app_hero_card_hint: Only this device: it overrides the hero card chosen in Admin, on the Frontend page. Technical lays the recipe graph under the numbers; Colorful is the classic full-color card.
strings.settings.app_hero_colors_hint: Only the Colorful hero card follows these colours — Technical keeps the forecast colours of its graph zones. While a shot runs, By forecast fades the card from coffee brown toward the colour it predicts — red for fast, green for on recipe, blue for slow — as the shot progresses and confidence grows, reaching the full colour a few seconds before the end. A slow shot shows the projected weight, and a stalled one says what it is tracking to. By time window instead turns it green while the shot is inside the window, and a finished shot always takes the colour of its result.
strings.settings.app_keep_awake: Keep the screen on while a shot runs
strings.settings.app_keep_awake_hint: The screen stays on from the start of an extraction until a minute after it ends, even outside the live view.
strings.settings.app_offline_confirm: Delete the shots saved in this app for offline use? They download again the next time you open Shots or History.
strings.settings.app_offline_delete: Delete the copy in this app
strings.settings.app_offline_hint: This app keeps your shots so it can show them with the controller off.
strings.settings.app_orientation_hint: The live view stays upright however you turn the phone. Android only.
strings.settings.app_scope_note: These settings are saved only in this browser or device, not in the controller. Each phone and browser keeps its own.
strings.settings.app_vibrate_hint: A short buzz when the extraction finishes. Android only.
strings.settings.assume_idle_when_the_scale_conn: Assume idle when the scale connects
strings.settings.automatic_tare_outside_a_brew: Tare when you place a cup
strings.settings.avoid_accidental_touch_hint: Ignore brief touches that could stop or extend a shot.
strings.settings.beeps_when_a_scale_connects_or_: A rising tone when a scale connects or reconnects.
strings.settings.beeps_when_brew_by_weight_is_on: Warns when a By weight shot can't start normally because no scale is connected.
strings.settings.beeps_when_the_scale_disconnect: Warns when the scale disconnects, so you know weight stops may not work.
strings.settings.blocks_once_then_allows_brewing: The first start is blocked with a warning. Start again to brew manually.
strings.settings.boost_scale_detection_when_mach: Find the scale faster while the Micra is on
Your scale connects sooner after you switch the Micra on.
strings.settings.brew_temperature_hint: Sent to the Micra when you choose this preset, if Set brew temperature per preset is on.
strings.settings.brew_without_a_scale: You start and stop the shot. Only the 60 s safety limit applies.
strings.settings.button_press_hint: Starts or stops on press. With Quick rinse on, a hold from idle becomes a rinse.
strings.settings.button_release_hint: Starts or stops on a short release. With Quick rinse on, a hold from idle starts a rinse, never a shot.
strings.settings.buzzer_only_hint: Every alert plays on the buzzer.
strings.settings.combine_tare_timer_at_shot_star: Tares and starts the Bookoo timer in one step.
strings.settings.cup_min_guidance: This cup reads about {x} g empty — below the {n} g cup minimum. Lower Minimum cup weight below {x} g, or cup detection and late tare won't recognize it.
strings.settings.delay_weight_stopping: Weight can't stop the shot before this, so tare settling and bumps are ignored.
strings.settings.disconnect_account_confirm: Disconnect the La Marzocco account? Saved credentials and the selected machine will be removed.
strings.settings.dose_hint: Coffee in the basket, for the ratio. The shot stops on yield.
strings.settings.drip_compensation_hint: Stops the pump early so the drips that follow land on your target.
strings.settings.drip_expected: Expected drip weight after the shot stops
strings.settings.drip_expected_g: Expected drip weight after the shot stops (g)
strings.settings.drip_set_hint: How much coffee still drips into the cup after the shot stops. The value you set is used from your next shot, then adjusts itself with every shot; if your next 3 shots agree on a different amount, it moves there straight away. Not sure? Start from 0.5 g.
strings.settings.eclair_uses_the_normal_tare_and: Eclair uses the regular tare and timer workflow. It has no extra volume or sound options; alerts it cannot play use the built-in buzzer when available.
strings.settings.enable_cup_protections_also_in_: Stops or blocks shots based on the cup. Rinses always run.
strings.settings.extra_wait_for_the_scale_timer_: Delays only the scale's timer stop, never the shot. Raise it if the scale's time lags.
strings.settings.fast_margin_hint: Full amount for shots well before your window, less as they near it.
strings.settings.fast_protection_hint: Runs a few grams long to soften sourness. Finer grind fixes it.
strings.settings.fast_ramp_hint: How long the extra grams take to fade out as a shot nears your window. 0 switches straight to your target.
strings.settings.fast_shot_pulse_hint: Beeps while a fast shot runs past its target.
strings.settings.first_detected_is_shown_until_a: The scale used by My scale first and Only my scale. Until one is saved, the first scale to connect becomes yours.
strings.settings.grind_hints_hint: Suggests a grind change when your shots drift. Never changes a setting.
strings.settings.how_long_the_automatic_button_p: How long the controller presses the button to stop. Enough for one normal press.
strings.settings.how_long_the_cup_must_stay_stea: Longer ignores bumps, but tare and cup checks react later.
strings.settings.how_long_to_hold_the_switch_fro: Hold this long from idle to start a rinse; it then runs for Rinse duration.
strings.settings.how_long_water_runs_through_the: Water runs this long, then stops. 2–5 s before a shot; 5–10 s to clean the screen.
strings.settings.how_long_you_can_leave_the_padd: Leave the paddle ON longer than this and it becomes a shot.
strings.settings.how_loud_the_scale_is_when_it: Alert volume on the Bookoo speaker (
strings.settings.late_cup_window_measured_from_s: Keep it shorter than your time to first drops.
strings.settings.learning_speed_hint: How much each shot moves the drip. Higher reacts faster; lower is steadier. After many shots it can tune itself if another speed would have landed closer.
strings.settings.lets_you_flush_the_group_with_a: Flick the paddle ON and straight back OFF to rinse. Off: a short flick is a short shot.
Hold the switch from idle to rinse. Off: a long press is left to the machine.
strings.settings.lightest_stable_weight_that_cou: Lightest cup that counts. Too low and small loads may look like a cup.
strings.settings.lights_the_blue_led_while_a_sca: Lit while a scale is connected. Off keeps it dark; the connection isn't affected.
strings.settings.longest_hold_that_still_counts_: Up to this long counts as a tap. Longer holds go to the machine or start a rinse.
strings.settings.machine_power_hint: Lets the controller know whether the Micra is on or in standby.
strings.settings.max_bbw_time_hint: Shots under weight control stop here at the latest; others at the 60 s safety limit.
strings.settings.maximum_500_characters_the_tune: Paste a tune in RTTTL format, up to 500 characters. Kept while the melody is off.
strings.settings.maximum_difference_between_the_: How much readings may vary and still count as steady.
strings.settings.maximum_gap_between_stable_cup_: Raise only if a slow scale keeps missing a steady cup.
strings.settings.micra_choose_intro: Which Linea Micra is this controller paired with?
strings.settings.micra_cloud_hint: Sign in with the account you use in the La Marzocco app. It works through the La Marzocco cloud, so brewing never waits for it.
strings.settings.micra_connecting: Connecting to your La Marzocco account…
strings.settings.micra_email_hint: The same email you use to sign in to the La Marzocco app.
strings.settings.micra_intro: See when your Micra is on and warmed up, set the brew temperature in each preset, and let your scale turn the machine on and off.
strings.settings.micra_linked_note: Connected. The recommended options below are on, and you can adjust any of them.
strings.settings.micra_machine_hint: The La Marzocco app shows each machine's name and serial number.
strings.settings.micra_needs_wifi: Connect the controller to your home Wi-Fi first. Signing in needs the internet, which isn't available while the setup network is open.
strings.settings.micra_password_hint: Kept on the controller so it stays signed in after a restart. It's never shown again.
strings.settings.micra_scope_note: These settings only work while your La Marzocco machine is connected, and they stay the same whichever preset you use.
strings.settings.monitor_machine_power_state_hin: Shows On, Standby or Eco on Home. The options below rely on it.
strings.settings.name: Name
strings.settings.new_coffee_confirm: Relearn {0}? Use this after a new bag or any change to your dose, basket or grinder. Grind tweaks are noticed automatically, so you don't need it for those. Grind hints, the scale-loss backup and the graph's reference pace then learn from your next shots; the {1} shots so far are set aside and your settings don't change.
strings.settings.no_brand_specific_settings: This scale uses the shared scale, tare, timer, and alert settings above; there are no additional options for this brand.
strings.settings.off_keeps_tare_timer_physical_s: Stops at your target yield. Off: you stop it, with tare, timer and the 60 s limit.
strings.settings.one_beep_when_the_first_coffee_: One beep when the first drops appear in a By weight shot.
strings.settings.original_mode_hint: ON, then OFF after the first second: the shot runs to your yield. To stop early, ON then OFF again. Left ON, it runs to the 60 s safety limit. OFF in the first second stops it, or starts a rinse if Quick rinse is on. Without weight control, OFF stops normally.
strings.settings.play_a_custom_rtttl_melody_when: Plays when an On recipe shot settles exactly on your target. Needs
strings.settings.power_on_machine_with_scale: Turn the Micra on with the scale
strings.settings.power_on_machine_with_scale_hin: The machine starts heating whenever the scale is switched on, even if you're not next to it. Reconnecting after a lost signal never turns it on.
strings.settings.prefer_selected_hint: Waits briefly for your scale, then accepts another.
strings.settings.preset_name_hint: E.g. "Double · Kenya". One preset per basket keeps drip learning accurate.
strings.settings.preset_tap_hint: Tap a preset to use and review it.
strings.settings.presets_scope_note: Everything below is saved with the selected preset and only applies while that preset is active.
strings.settings.protection_returns_after_hint: After a warning or override, brewing without a scale stays allowed this long.
strings.settings.quick_override_note: Changed for now from the header. This shows your saved setting.
strings.settings.ramp_fast_early: Drops the extra grams early, then settles onto your target, so only clearly fast shots get them.
strings.settings.ramp_fast_even: Eases out of the full margin and onto your target evenly.
strings.settings.ramp_fast_late: Keeps most of the extra grams until close to your window, then settles onto your target.
strings.settings.ramp_limited_fast: Shortened to {0} s: weight stops start at {1} s (Earliest weight stop).
strings.settings.ramp_limited_slow: Shortened to {0} s: the shot ends at {1} s (Max shot time).
strings.settings.ramp_slow_early: Comes down soon after your window, then settles onto the full amount, so slightly slow shots are shortened too.
strings.settings.ramp_slow_even: Leaves your target and settles onto the full amount evenly.
strings.settings.ramp_slow_late: Stays near your target for a while, so only clearly slow shots are shortened by the full amount.
strings.settings.recognize_wake_gesture_hint: In standby, the first paddle press only wakes the machine — no shot is started.
strings.settings.reduce_scale_scanning_when_mach: Search for the scale less in standby
Saves energy; the scale may take a moment longer to connect.
strings.settings.reminds_you_to_return_the_paddl: After an automatic stop, beeps at this interval until the paddle is back at OFF.
strings.settings.restore_confirm: Restore {0} to factory values? Its name is kept; drip learning and shot stats start over. Shared settings don't change.
strings.settings.retare_accessory_hint: Tares a jug added to an auto-tared cup, and again when removed. Beans count too: turn off if you dose here.
strings.settings.retare_accessory_outside_brew: Tare items added to a cup
strings.settings.rtttl_not_saved: Not a valid RTTTL tune, so it was not saved.
strings.settings.scale_automations_hint: Use the scale's power button to control the machine.
strings.settings.scale_loss_enabled: Finish by time if the scale drops
strings.settings.scale_loss_enabled_hint: If the scale disconnects mid-shot, it stops at about the time your recent shots took.
strings.settings.scale_loss_ended_beep_hint: Confirms a shot was finished by time after the scale disconnected.
strings.settings.scale_loss_fixed_link: Set a fixed time for this preset
strings.settings.scale_loss_override_hint: Used if the scale disconnects mid-shot. Empty: from recent shots or the window.
strings.settings.scale_only_hint: Alerts the scale can't play stay silent; shot start and stop use the buzzer.
strings.settings.shared_scope_note: These settings don't belong to any preset. They work the same whichever preset you brew with.
strings.settings.shot_window_hint: On recipe if it reaches the target in this window. Earlier is Fast, later is Slow.
strings.settings.shutdown_grace_period_hint: Switch the scale back on within this time to cancel.
strings.settings.shutdown_machine_with_scale: Standby when the scale turns off
strings.settings.shutdown_machine_with_scale_hin: Never during a shot or rinse, and a lost scale signal doesn't count.
strings.settings.slow_margin_hint: Full amount for shots well after your window, less as they near it.
strings.settings.slow_protection_hint: Stops a few grams short to cut bitterness. Coarser grind fixes it.
strings.settings.slow_ramp_hint: How long the cut takes to come down by the full amount after your window. 0 drops it right away.
strings.settings.slow_shot_pulse_hint: Beeps while a slow shot is being shortened.
strings.settings.stable_readings_required_for_id: More readings ignore bumps, but tare and cup checks react later.
strings.settings.stop_if_the_tared_cup_is_remove: Lifting the cup stops a By weight shot. Turn off if you swap cups mid-shot.
strings.settings.stops_reminding_after_this_time: Reminders stop after this, even if the paddle stays ON.
strings.settings.tare_a_late_cup_once_within_the: Set the cup down just after starting: it's tared once. Needs Tare when the shot starts.
strings.settings.tare_at_shot_start_including_ti: Zeroes the scale at every start. Turn off only if you tare it yourself.
strings.settings.tare_each_stable_cup_placement_: Zeroes a cup you place between shots, once the reading is steady.
strings.settings.target_weight_hint: Drink weight in the cup, drips included.
strings.settings.the_paddle_works_like_a_normal_: Like the stock machine: ON starts, OFF stops. Leave it ON to stop at your yield. With Quick rinse on, ON then OFF in the first second starts a rinse.
strings.settings.the_shot_will_not_start_until_a: By weight shots need a cup on the scale; rinses don't. Already on? Lift and replace it.
strings.settings.timed_from_start: Timed from the start, pre-infusion included.
strings.settings.touch_stop_fallback_hint: If a bump blocks the weight stop, the shot still stops after 1 s over target.
strings.settings.turn_scale_off_with_machine: Turn the scale off with the Micra
strings.settings.turn_scale_off_with_machine_hin: When the Micra goes to standby, a supported scale switches off too.
strings.settings.turns_all_brew_alert_sounds_on_: Off mutes every brew sound; your choices below are kept.
strings.settings.use_the_first_scale_found_prefe: Connects to the first scale it finds.
strings.settings.wait_for_drips_before_saving_fi: The yield is recorded this long after the stop. Keep the cup on the scale until then.
strings.settings.wait_for_zero_after_tare_before: After a tare, weight can't stop the shot while the reading settles.
strings.settings.weight_at_or_below_this_means_t: How far below zero counts as a lifted cup. Closer to zero reacts sooner.
strings.settings.when_alerts_use_only_the_buzzer: Keeps the Bookoo silent so alerts play on the buzzer. Applies when
strings.settings.when_the_scale_connects_and_you: Marks the machine idle when a scale connects. Turn off if it may connect mid-shot.
strings.settings.where_alert_sounds_play_scale_p: Uses the scale's speaker when it can, else the buzzer. Shot start and stop always use the buzzer.
strings.settings.won_t_brew_without_a_scale_togg: Blocked until a scale connects. To override, switch ON and OFF three times within 2 s, then start again.

strings.setup.mode_title: How do you want to brew?
strings.setup.mode_usual_hint: The controller stays out of the way. The paddle runs the machine directly, just as before.
strings.setup.mode_weight_hint: Ends each shot at your target weight. Requires a compatible Bluetooth scale, such as Bookoo, Felicita, or Decent.

strings.setup.nothing_until_save: Nothing changes on the machine until you save.

strings.setup.part1_hint_choices: Choose how you want to brew. It is saved at the end of this part.
strings.setup.part1_hint_password: Replace the factory password with your own. It is saved at the end of this part.

strings.setup.part3_hint_on: Everything is already saved by then. Done closes the setup network.
strings.setup.part_wifi_hint: Connect the controller to your home network, check that it works, then save it so you can open the controller from your phone.
strings.setup.pass_note: Your password unlocks Admin and joins the setup network {x}. If you ever forget it, you can bring back the factory password from the machine's paddle without losing your recipes.
strings.setup.password_intro: The password you used to join this setup network is the factory one, and it is the same on every controller. Choose your own so nobody else can change your settings.
strings.setup.password_not_saved: The controller did not confirm the new password. Try again.
strings.setup.recipe_double_adaptive_hint: For a double basket. Stops at your target weight and adjusts a little for fast and slow shots.
strings.setup.recipe_double_fixed_hint: For a double basket. Always stops right at your target weight.
strings.setup.recipe_intro: You can switch recipes any time from the Home screen.
strings.setup.recipe_manual_hint: You stop each shot yourself while the controller weighs and times it. A relaxed way to get started.
strings.setup.recipe_single_adaptive_hint: For a single basket. Stops at your target weight and adjusts a little for fast and slow shots.
strings.setup.recipe_single_fixed_hint: For a single basket. Always stops right at your target weight.

strings.setup.wifi_not_saved: The controller did not confirm the network yet. Try again.
